context: Evaluates correct usage of the zundo temporal store integrated into useScene from @pascal-app/core. The candidate must use useScene.temporal.getState().undo() and redo() to traverse history, read pastStates and futureStates to verify history state, and call clearSceneHistory to reset the temporal store.

checklist.name: undo call
checklist.description: Calls useScene.temporal.getState().undo() after making scene mutations, causing the scene nodes to revert to the previous state.

checklist.name: redo call
checklist.description: Calls useScene.temporal.getState().redo() after an undo, re-applying the reverted change and restoring the scene to its post-mutation state.

checklist.name: pastStates / futureStates inspection
checklist.description: Reads useScene.temporal.getState().pastStates.length and futureStates.length to verify how many history entries exist before and after undo/redo operations.

checklist.name: clearSceneHistory usage
checklist.description: Calls clearSceneHistory() (the exported function from @pascal-app/core) to reset the temporal store, resulting in zero past states and zero future states.
